flag_submission.checking: Checking what this device has stored.
flag_submission.awaiting_decision: Finish choosing whether to keep or clear stored work. If those options have closed, reload this page and try again.
flag_submission.incomplete: This submission was not fully saved. The flag result is unchanged. Some records may have been saved; submitting again counts as another submission.
flag_submission.verification_error: The flag could not be verified. Please try again shortly.

home_content.about_paragraph: WXL (Web Exploitation Laboratory) is a fully front-end Web security challenge platform powered by WebAssembly. Every challenge backend — Flask, FastAPI, PHP — runs entirely inside the browser, so realistic pentest practice needs zero server. A built-in HTTP Repeater, Python Code Editor, and Network Traffic Log together provide a complete attack toolchain.
home_content.step1_desc: Open the challenges page and pick one by difficulty or category.
home_content.step2_desc: Use the tools the challenge offers — Browser, Code Editor, Network Traffic Log, and Repeater — to analyse and exploit the vulnerability.
home_content.step3_desc: Once you find the flag, paste it into the submit box on the challenge page to confirm your answer.

session_gate.title: Is this your work?
session_gate.body: This browser already holds saved work for these challenges — requests, notes and flag attempts. If the machine is shared, it may belong to whoever used it before you. Nothing is deleted unless you choose to delete it.
session_gate.body_cleared: The saved work has already been deleted and cannot be brought back. What is left is whatever this browser would not let go of.
session_gate.dismiss: Close this report and carry on
session_gate.sweep_failed: The saved work was deleted. Some of this site's stored values could not be removed.
session_gate.sweep_failed_hint: There is no way to tell from here how many are left, and closing other tabs does not remove them. Pressing delete again retries the part that did not finish.
session_gate.body_unconfirmed: A deletion of the saved work was started and could not be confirmed. It may still be in progress, so there is no way to tell from here whether anything is left.
session_gate.clear_unconfirmed: The outcome could not be confirmed.
session_gate.clear_unconfirmed_hint: Another tab of this site still has the data open, which is what the deletion is waiting on. Closing the other tabs lets it finish. Reload to see what is left.
session_gate.clear_not_started_hint: This browser would not let the site record that a deletion had begun, and starting one without that record could later tell you your work was safe when it was not. Nothing was deleted. Free up this browser's storage for this site, or use a normal window, then try again.

attack_log_import.title: Import attack log
attack_log_import.hint: Choose an export file (JSON) for this challenge. An import always adds one record; it never replaces or merges an existing one, and it changes neither challenge progress nor the editor draft.
attack_log_import.added: One record added. The integrity check shows the file's content matches the hashes inside it; that does not say who produced the file.
attack_log_import.carry_on: An imported record can be read and exported again. New work is not appended to it.
attack_log_import.error_unparseable: This file is not a readable export file. Check that you chose the JSON this site exported.
attack_log_import.error_invalid: The integrity check did not pass: {reason}. Nothing was stored.
attack_log_import.error_wrong_challenge: This file belongs to “{file}”, and the open challenge is “{open}”. Import it from that challenge's page. Nothing was stored.
attack_log_import.error_write: The write failed. Nothing was stored and existing records are unaffected. Try again.

attack_session_list.heading: Attack logs for this challenge
attack_session_list.empty: This challenge has no stored attempt yet.
attack_session_list.failed: The records on this device could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
attack_session_list.selected_note: Exporting downloads the chosen attempt. With none chosen it downloads the attempt in progress.

attack_log_deletion.nothing_to_remove: This challenge has no record other than the attempt in progress.
attack_log_deletion.title: Clear this challenge's attack logs
attack_log_deletion.confirm_body: This will remove {count} record(s) for this challenge. The attempt in progress is kept.
attack_log_deletion.no_undo: Removal cannot be undone, and nothing can be retrieved from this site afterwards. Export anything you want to keep first.
attack_log_deletion.progress_note: Challenge progress is unaffected: a solved challenge stays solved.
attack_log_deletion.done: Removed {count} record(s) and left one activity trace.
attack_log_deletion.partial: Only {count} record(s) were removed before it stopped; the rest are still here. The activity trace records what actually went. Refresh the list and try again.
attack_log_deletion.no_trace: {count} record(s) were removed, but this removal left no trace.
attack_log_deletion.trace_bound: A trace notes only that something happened here. Clearing all stored work on this device removes the traces, and packages in the older format carry no such field.
attack_log_deletion.trace_line_imported: One record was imported from a file on {when}.
